items.evidence: README play command (and examen leverage play <runs>/large-batch-2 --ticks 5) printed one JSON object at screen title with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts.
README frame command wrote frame.png: 'PNG image data, 800 x 480'; also wrote play/title/settings/shop frames at 800x480.
Fresh place, 3 ticks: texts exactly [name, 'Best: 0', Start, Settings, Quit], saved false; 1:enter -> play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate 10.

Settings: 4x right from 8 -> volume 10, 12x left -> 0; language right -> es, right -> fr, third right stays fr, left from en stays en; difficulty Normal by default, right -> hard (stays), left -> easy.

es/fr texts on title, settings, play, paused, shop, lost, won all translated (e.g. 'Mejor: 0','Empezar','Oleada 1 de 8','Albañil: puerta 10/10 - 4 monedas','Has ganado'; 'Meilleur : 0','Vague 1 sur 8','Maçon : porte 10/10 - 4 pièces','Défaite'); only the game name stays English.
Check run set volume 6, French, Hard in place k; next run in k started with volume 6, fr, hard and gate 7 on Start; a fresh place started with 8, en, normal.
Up held 30 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 9 (6 u/s); held on stays 12; down held stays 0.
Held shoot, nothing bought: bolts 5.6 apart (24 ticks x 14/60), moving 0.2333/tick; a bolt at 19.27 is gone next frames (none kept past 20).
Seed 1 wave 1: walkers spawn at x=20 every 90 ticks in lanes 4,10,6,2,6, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick; 5 in all.
Scripted wave 1: walker health 2 -> 1 on a bolt, second hit removes it, score 10 coins 1; guard at y 6 shooting for 300 ticks left the lane-4 walker at health 2 while lane-6 walker was destroyed.
No shooting: each walker reaching x=0 removed, gate -1, score/coins 0 (shop at gate 5); wave 2 drove gate to 0 at ~tick 2425: screen lost, texts ['You lost','Score: 0','Best: 0','Enter: title'].
Difficulty Easy then Start: gate_health 14; Hard then Start: gate_health 7.

After wave 1 cleared (tick ~465) screen shop, guard_y frozen, no enemies/bolts; texts ['Shop','Coins: 5','Next: wave 2 of 8','Quick hands 0/2 - 5 coins','Heavy bolts 0/1 - 12 coins','Mason: gate 10/10 - 4 coins','Next wave'].
start_coins=30: one Quick hands -> coins 30, bolts 4.2 apart (18 ticks); twice -> coins 20, bolts 2.8 apart (12 ticks); third Enter left coins 20 and quick 2.
Heavy bought (35 -> 23); going back to it and Enter again kept coins 23, heavy 1; in wave 2 a single bolt removed a health-2 walker (+10, +1 coin).
Gate 5, coins 30: Mason -> 8/26, -> 10/22 (capped), again -> 10/22; at full gate Enter left coins 5 gate 10; gate 5 with 0 coins Enter left both unchanged.
Next wave handled at tick 489, first enemy at x=20 at tick 549 (60 later); wave 2 had 7 walkers; HUD 'Wave 2 of 8'.
start_wave=3: 6 walkers every 72 ticks, then runners from clock 432 every 72, 4 of them, health 1, 0.05/tick (3 u/s); shooting one gave score 15 coins 1.
start_wave=4: 8 walkers then a brute at clock 576, health 6, 1/60 per tick; reaching gate 92 -> 89; shot 6 times gave score 40 coins 3.
modules/work/waves.csv holds walkers,runners,brutes,seconds per wave (read by waves()); README 'Change a wave' explains editing it.
start_wave=7,start_gate=100 (builder's test aid; no unbroken 8-wave scripted run): wave 7 -> shop -> Next wave -> wave 8 -> won with score 1425 = 145 points + 20 x 64 gate; Enter on won -> title.
Escape at tick 100: paused, enemies/bolts/guard identical ticks 101-199; Resume continued from same positions; Escape then Title -> title screen.
Shop opened with saved true; next run in same place: texts [name,'Best: 0','Start','Continue','Settings','Quit'].
Continue -> shop wave 1, score 50, coins 5; bought Quick hands, ended run; Continue again -> quick 1, coins 0, score 50; Next wave -> play wave 2 'Wave 2 of 8'.
Pause->Title left saved true and Continue shown; Start made saved false, next title had no Continue; after a lost run and after a won run the next title had saved false, no Continue.
Won with 1425 -> next run title 'Best: 1425'; later lost run with 0 showed 'Best: 1425' on lost screen and title kept 1425; won screen showed 'Best: 1425'.
Two 900-tick runs (seed 3, same script) from identical copies of a kept place printed byte-identical JSON; seed 7 vs seed 1 wave 1 lanes 6,10,6,10,8 vs 4,10,6,2,6.

Frame at tick 900 of wave 8: gate bar left (height ~ gate 6/10), blue guard at y 8, green walkers, flat yellow runners, large red brute, white bolts at the state's x,y (40 px/unit); HUD Score/Coins/Wave 8 of 8/Gate.
Frames: French title with Réglages outlined (menu_index 1), French settings with Difficulté outlined, Spanish shop with Flechas pesadas outlined.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json hold all words; ui files use @keys, rules contain no shown words; README 'Add a language' explains it.
README has How to play, Where things are kept (settings folder, kept.best, kept.saved_run), and the play and frame commands, both of which ran as written.

defects: After buying Heavy bolts (and when a line changes to its 'full' text) the shop focus jumps back to Quick hands, so a second Enter meant for the same line buys Quick hands instead (seen: 35 -> 23 -> 18 coins, quick 1).
The play HUD (Score/Coins/Wave/Gate) is drawn behind the title, settings and shop menus in frames, though those strings are not in the state's texts.
With the start_gate test aid the shop shows 'Mason: gate 86/10' (gate above its max); only reachable through the test aid.
An input at tick 0 is lost (the title is not up yet); README says so.
